notes.title: May 11th 2014 patch notes for Narcissu 1st & 2nd
notes.notes:
This update only updates the engine and does not touch the game script files so saves should not be harmed.

Bugs fixed: 

#28 - Workaround for bug in SDL2 regarding maximizing the game, minimizing the game, and then restoring the game.

#29, #59,#60, #61 - Making the game less picky about mouse click detection to fix reported issues
